description:
Vertical Drop Heroes HD is a roguelike platformer where you descend
procedurally generated levels, unlocking traits and powers between runs.

v0.1.0.description:
First playable Vertical Drop Heroes HD Archipelago version!

Installation instructions:
1. Install the game through Steam (or some other drm-free version)
2. Make a copy of it to mod (or do it in place, your call, but it'll muck with your save)
3. Add the win32 gm-apclientpp.dll into that folder. https://github.com/black-sliver/gm-apclientpp/releases
4. Add UndertaleModToolCli into that folder. https://github.com/UnderminersTeam/UndertaleModTool/releases
5. Unzip vdh-ap-patcher into that folder.
6. Double-click patch.bat.

When launching the game, the Options menu will have an Archipelago option that can connect. Add port/slot, select "connect" (space bar), and close, then launch single player (co-op does not function in AP).

v0.2.0.description:
Improved the release packaging.
Added shrine locations.
Added traps.
Added hard level gating logic.

v0.3.0.description:
* Fixed Deathlink text to reference slotname instead of character name
* Fixed a bug where the second merchant in a level would show the wrong display text
* Added a "end this run early" option in the pause menu to allow exiting a run without sending deathlink
* Fixed a bug where gold would carry over between slots
* Added instrumentation to catch logs for future issues (ap_debug.log)
